about: Every difference between the CLI's spend gate and the stack's wallet-gate vectors (tests/vectors/wallet_gate_vectors.json at its pin), by row, door and field, with the finding it belongs to. tests/gate_vectors.rs holds this list exact: a difference not here fails, an entry that no longer differs fails. A finding is the gate's to fix, never a row's: when the gate changes, its entries leave this file in the same commit. docs/GATE-VECTORS.md.

stale-door-reads-seen.what: A creator whose tracker word is stale is held 'stale: never offered' by hold_reason; Wallet.doorWord reads stale as seen (ruling 7, the orphaned and latch cases), so under the host's own-change rule or the action's received word the Lean offers the coin and its door is open.

no-lineage.what: The gate judges the creator only; Wallet.deadLineage holds a coin when some ancestor of ours is dead (void parent, the lvDead cases), so the gate offers coins the Lean holds as 'dead lineage'.

fork-recheck-clears-suspect.what: A fork stored from the feed marks the creator suspect, but the spend guard's own recheck (SpendAttempt then Recheck, tracker_host readme_spend_guard) clears the mark while the header at the creator's height still carries its root, so the gate offers the coin; the Lean holds it while the fork is in progress ('creator suspect'). An open split (tracker_meta open_splits) is not cleared this way.
